validation.leagueNameLength: League name must be between 3 and 64 characters
validation.displayNameLength: Display name must be between 2 and 32 characters
validation.survivalCapRange: Survival cap must be either 0 (no cap) or less than 15
validation.maxBetPositive: Max bet must be positive or 0 for unlimited.
validation.maxBetsPerWeekMin: Max bets per week must be at least 1 or 0 for unlimited.
validation.maxBetsPerWeekMax: Max bets per week cannot exceed 10
validation.atLeastOneBetType: At least one bet type must be enabled
validation.customStartWeekRequired: Custom start week must be set and at least 3 when start week is Custom
validation.tribeUpdateReferences: Tribe Update events must reference at least one tribe and one castaway
